proposed_status_reason: A for the finite immutable shipped-resource domain (81 distinct records, both complete orders, all 23 descriptor geometries), and actual-C symbolic raw decoding. This does not close LoadCurrentLevelState initialization, arbitrary synthetic reference graphs, or resource mutation.

L0: GAME:LoadCurrentLevelState 013B:3976 record/list readers; no claim to replace the routine
DGROUP 81 level records 5C09:3479..3CB2; platform/placement lists; descriptors 5C09:7630..7A4B
L1: c/render.c:c_LoadCurrentLevelState, reads compared after all 150 ordered level loads

purpose: Provide read-only resource views for level maps, landing platforms, placements and the descriptor geometry used by contacts. Preserve unresolved source bytes without converting machine callbacks or inventing simulation state.

inputs: The immutable shipped DOS level records/lists and decoded 32000-byte map bank; all 81 records in both 69/81 orders
Accessible initialized byte inputs for native decoders; separately allocated output and bridge storage
Geometry decode: any four descriptor words; item decode: first two words and fixed extents three
outputs: LevelDescription with const borrowed tiles/platform/placement pointers and explicit counts
LevelPlatform left/right pixel bounds, aspect-converted surface Y, arrival/wait/spawn anchors, destination icon/type and skipped raw word
ObjectGeometry anchor and extent words; current object positions are a separate borrowed view
Bridge returns one on projection success, zero on capacity/map/unknown-enemy rejection without publishing output view
effects: Reads source only, writes caller-provided storage/view; no persistent native globals, allocation, callbacks or device operations
Every packed level byte retained, including +09/+19 and encoded references; actor placement +4 retained raw; complete variable enemy placement retained raw
preconditions: Ordinary stable RAM; source level/list records do not cross the 16-bit offset endpoint; no concurrent resource mutation or device aliases
Storage/view do not alias inputs; borrowed const pointers remain valid for consumer lifetime
The immutable closure domain is the exact shipped tables. Arbitrary synthetic/corrupt lists are compatibility extensions with weaker evidence
Descriptor geometry bridge permits any word operand offset, including FFFF with a contiguous second byte and wrapped next effective offset
interface.projection: Only the bridge resolves the encoded map/list/descriptor identities. Native APIs receive ordinary buffers, counts and typed views. The level raw bytes are opaque evidence, never dereferenced as machine addresses.
interface.scope: The stateful loader remains L1, including reverse-copy overlap, decompression, water/start corrections, weather/RNG and all actor/hazard initializers. No native loader or object state machine is claimed.
interface.platform_type: Input +0C is established as the destination HUD icon/type. No terrain/material type is inferred. Landing surfaces use existing platform bounds/surface_y.
interface.reserved_descriptors: Actor descriptor +3A/+3C and all callback/tail data outside the contact prefix remain uninterpreted in the unchanged immutable source tables; this API projects no fields for them.

callers: Contacts bridge borrows descriptor geometry on every call
Future native passenger/stone/hazard/item callers may borrow the shared views; no such caller migration is claimed

indirect.classification: No indirect transfers; stored code words are not executed or converted to native callbacks.

read: 81 packed records + map bank + terminated platform/actor/enemy lists + contact prefixes of 4 enemy/8 actor/11 item descriptors
Geometry accesses use contiguous word bytes and wrapped effective operand offsets
write: Caller-owned LevelProjectionStorage and LevelDescription only; partial storage allowed on rejected projection
owners: Immutable level/resource data; platform occupancy, actor callbacks, render caches and mutable current-record state are outside this projection
memory.aliases: Read-only source aliases are not mutated; native output metadata/storage must not alias source.

assumptions: Locked original expansion and independently decoded map bank
The finite shipped-resource membership is a contract restriction, not a theorem that malformed resources cannot occur
Compiler/C ABI and bridge memory accessors are trusted links; receipts pin compiler and source inputs

eliminated.detail: Machine references in ordinary resource APIs
eliminated.evidence: Bridge resolves them to const ordinary pointers; raw encoded fields are retained solely as opaque bytes.

eliminated.detail: Platform occupancy mixed with immutable platform description
eliminated.evidence: G:3A9E separately initializes occupants FFFF; native description contains no occupancy/state field.

retained.detail: Signed aspect conversion and word wrap
retained.reason: Y-SAR(Y,2) rounds negative odd values down before subtraction; native uses an explicit sign-filled shift.
No established meaning for level +09/+19, platform +E, bird/Triopterus/Dino skipped placement words or stone placement tail; preserve raw.

retained.detail: Descriptor geometry fields are unrestricted words
retained.reason: Do not substitute sprite width/height, pixel caches, or on-screen assumptions.

evidence.method: CBMC 6.11.0 on actual native C, arbitrary 26 input bytes; full field/raw relations, signed aspect rounding, borrowed-pointer identity, bounds/pointers/overflow/unwinding assertions.
evidence.result: PASS: 0/63 failed; no on-screen/canonical-word assumptions. This is a raw-decoding proof, not a whole-loader proof.

evidence.method: Actual compiled bridge/native projection versus independently checked dataprobe decoder, every 69+81 order entry and every descriptor; all projected fields, raw tails, counts, maps and unchanged source RAM checked.
evidence.result: PASS: 150 ordered entries, 81 distinct records, 806 platform uses, 493 actor placements, 265 enemy placements, all 23 descriptors; descriptor operand at FFFF checked. Complete only for this finite resource domain.

evidence.property: Projection agrees with actual L1 loader on shipped resources
evidence.method: Execute actual compiled c_LoadCurrentLevelState for all ordered inputs, then compare platform arrays/occupancy initialization, descriptor/platform identities, sentinels and all 320 tile bytes with native projection.
evidence.result: PASS: all 150 ordered loader executions; no L0 execution in this enumeration, no claim about unprojected initialization fields.

evidence.method: Maintained rebuilt-L0 differential suites, ordinary and poisoned register/flag environments; full observation model.
evidence.result: PASS: actors 974, actors_states 1044, items_water 210, render 526 = 2754/2754. Render includes real and synthetic loader cases; the loader remains L1.

evidence.method: Actual wholegame.main with isolated variant DLL and cached rebuilt-L0 references, worker-local reports.
evidence.result: PASS all 14 scenarios, 9963 frames plus terminal boundaries. Only descriptor geometry is consumed by contact bridges; no claim that the complete level-view projection replaces loader work in the scenarios.

amiga.classification: confirmed equivalent for enumerated level/platform data; similar purpose with different representations
amiga.finding: Fresh static extraction reproduces both level orders, shared playable maps and platform scalars. Amiga 38-byte levels, 18-byte platforms and 126/110/30-byte descriptors are not DOS layouts. Reserved bytes are not named from equality alone.

uncertainty: Arbitrary synthetic reference graphs/unknown enemy descriptors are not part of the finite immutable closure claim. Rejection leaves partial storage but does not publish the view.
Itineraries, text interpretation, descriptor callback/tail semantics and all object state are deliberately outside the geometry/level-view unit.
The original loader is not modernized; this closes its immutable input vocabulary only.
observation_chain: L0 reconstruction remains byte exact under its existing gates, unchanged by this work. The L0 -> L1 link here is C/D; finite/resource A and raw-C proofs apply only to L1/native projection.
